summary: Per-embedding usage ledger + field-provenance export for billing reconciliation
description:
Issue summary: Customer requests an export format that ties each embedding request to per-request billing units and field-level provenance. They need a SIEM-ready deliverable that contains a verifiable mapping from the embedding request ID to token/byte counts, model variant used, quantization profile (if applied), and a minimal HMAC proof per-record for auditability. Impact: Neptune's finance and security teams cannot reconcile monthly usage statements to their internal cost-allocation reports; they are unable to prove which product events generated the embedding billable units. They have a finance audit scheduled the week of 2026-03-22.

Objectives requested: 1) New export field: embed_usage {embedding_id, request_id, token_count, byte_count, model_hash, quant_profile, billing_bucket} 2) Per-record HMAC (customer-provided key) or signed-manifest for batches 3) Timezone-normalized timestamps (customer timezone: Europe/London) and canonical UTC column 4) Field-level provenance: source_route (api_key|route_id), original_prompt_truncation_flag, and inference_runtime_ms 5) A mapping CSV that joins export rows to monthly invoice line-items for reconciliation.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer runs embeddings generation pipeline (text-embedding-3-large) at 2026-03-10T14:03:22Z using route 'neptune-prod-embeds'. 2) They export audit rows via Console > Exports > Activity > ad-hoc for 2026-03-01..2026-03-10 with default schema. 3) They attempt to join the export to the invoice.csv on request_id and cannot because embed_usage fields were not present. 4) Attempted workaround: ad-hoc query adding token_count from usage ledger fails because request_id in ledger is different than export.request_uuid. Expected: matching request identifiers and per-record usage columns present.

comments: 2026-03-12 - Aisha Patel (Support): Opened ticket after customer escalation during billing reconciliation. Provided sample invoice and export. Asked for ETA on export schema change.

2026-03-12 - Neptune Analytics (Customer): We need per-embedding attribution to pass our external audit. Prefer HMAC per-record (we can supply key) and timezone normalization to Europe/London. Can you provide a short-term workaround while you ship the schema change?

2026-03-12 - Liam Chen (SRE): Acknowledged. Initial triage: looks like audit export v1 does not include embed_usage. We'll validate whether request_uuid is present in billing ledger; if not, we need to add a join key. Asked customer for a representative export + invoice rows.

2026-03-12 - Data Platform (Eng): Hypothesis: billing ledger stores billing_event_id that maps to internal rpc_id, not request_uuid. If so, we can add request_uuid to billing events during instrumentation; that requires a small runtime change and a migration for backfill. Est ETA for forward fix: 2 business days; backfill ETA depends on window size.

2026-03-13 - Support (Aisha): Shared a sample export and sample invoice lines from Neptune; customer confirmed they can provide HMAC key and accept a signed manifest if per-record HMAC is not immediately available.
investigation_notes: 1) Reproduced mismatch locally using Neptune sample export. Confirmed 'audit-export' rows are missing embed_usage block; they do include request_uuid but billing ledger contains billing_event_id only. 2) Traced emitting code in serving-runtime: embed pipeline emits two independent events (request_event and billing_event) and the billing_event currently includes rpc_trace_id but not request_uuid. 3) Quick patch option: add request_uuid to billing_event emitter (low-risk) and extend export schema to include embed_usage on next export pipeline release. 4) Backfill strategy: run a join on rpc_trace_id -> request_uuid for historical window (last 90 days) and produce a backfilled export CSV. Estimated time: 1 engineer, 2-3 days for runbook + safe backfill. 5) HMAC signing: Console export pipeline already supports signed-manifest for batch exports; per-record HMAC required additional support. Recommended approach: provide signed-manifest for this month's immediate audit and schedule per-record HMAC as an opt-in feature in 2 sprints.
resolution: Workaround: Provided Neptune with an ad-hoc, backfilled CSV that joins billing_event_id -> request_uuid for 2026-02-01..2026-03-10 and a signed-manifest for the batch (HMAC with customer's key). Short-term fix: deployed a non-breaking patch to emit request_uuid on billing_event (PR 1294), rolled out to staging 2026-03-13; production rollout scheduled 2026-03-14 under a gradual sharding policy. Long-term: Add embed_usage object to default audit export schema and per-record HMAC support (roadmap ticket created). Follow-up actions: schedule backfill run for 90-day window, provide Neptune with reconciliation script (CSV join + invoice mapping), and arrange a sync with Neptune's finance team on 2026-03-15.
notes_for_followup:
